label: Lesson 48
titleEn: Did You Want to Tell Me Something?

lines.en: Why did the writer become very worried?
lines.cn: 为什么作者会变得非常担心呢？

lines.en: Dentists always ask questions when it is impossible for you to answer.
lines.cn: 牙医总是在你无法回答问题的时候提问。

lines.en: My dentist had just pulled out one of my teeth and had told me to rest for a while.
lines.cn: 我的牙医刚刚拔掉了我的一颗牙齿，然后让我休息一会儿。

lines.en: but my mouth was full of cotton wool.
lines.cn: 但我的嘴里塞满了棉花。

lines.en: He knew I collected match boxes and asked me whether my collection was growing.
lines.cn: 他知道我喜欢收集火柴盒，便问我这个收藏是否还在继续增加。

lines.en: He then asked me how my brother was and whether I liked my new job in London.
lines.cn: 接着他又问我弟弟的情况，以及我是否喜欢在伦敦的新工作。

lines.en: In answer to these questions I either nodded or made strange noises.
lines.cn: 对于这些问题，我只能点头或者发出一些奇怪的声音作为回答。

lines.en: Meanwhile, my tongue was busy searching out the hole where the tooth had been.
lines.cn: 与此同时，我的舌头一直在寻找那颗牙齿曾经所在的位置。

lines.en: I suddenly felt very worried, but could not say anything.
lines.cn: 我突然感到非常担心，但却什么也说不出来。

lines.en: When the dentist at last removed the cotton wool from my mouth,
lines.cn: 直到牙医终于把嘴里的棉花取出来，

lines.en: I was able to tell him that he had pulled out the wrong tooth.
lines.cn: 我才告诉他，他拔错了牙齿。
